node.title: Re: execute remote perl script via ssh
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Have you looked at the values of $ssh_user, $hostname, and $user via e.g. [doc://Data::Dumper]? Do you know whether ssh.exe is always in the PATH? Also, you should definitely be using a module to run external commands more safely, for example in this case I think [mod://IPC::Run3] might be appropriate (more info and sample code [id://1180578|here]). At the very least, use [mod://Win32::ShellQuote] to build the command line.
